entry.title: New: Bill 129 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTIONS 14.04.040, 14.07.080 AND 14.10.010, MAUI COUNTY CODE, TO ESTABLISH NEW WATER RATES, AND ALLOW FOR WAIVER OF THE WATER SYSTEM DEVELOPMENT FEE AND WATER SERVICE INSTALLATION FEES DURING EMERGENCIES" The purpose of this bill is to offer reduced rates for water for impacted customers and allows the Director to waive the water system development fee and water service installation costs.
